text:
Great software system. Very intuitive and looks absolutely great.

Most importantly, I had some things I wanted it to do that were not implemented. I requested the features, Ankit started an online meeting with me and the features were implemented within hours.

Stellar support that is hands-down better than others.

I highly suggest you use Formester over the other options since it is so simple to use and Ankit is very focused on meeting users requirements/needs. You're not going to find that with the competition.
